are_you_ok.title: Number of CPS Energy customers without power drops to the hundreds days after storms tear through San Antonio

you_should_know.title: Feds ordered to extend pause on Big Bend border construction, state senator says
you_should_know.description: The pause, previously in place until Sept. 15, was extended by 15 days, Texas State Senator Roland Gutierrez said Monday afternoon.
